title: EMB-2.2: pick from a neutral start, every tick applied
why: The EMB-2.2 test applies only the first action (applied_any short-circuits _apply at line 448), so both builds staged the pick; review on PR #20 rejected them

ops.text: From the Panda home pose with the cube resting on the table, the scripted policy lifts the cube 4 cm by contact within 60 simulated seconds, its per-tick action applied at every 50 Hz step
